description: Write properties such as part number, description or material. Only editable properties are accepted; read onshape_get_metadata first to find the property ids.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

part.description: Part id, to set that part's properties instead of the element's.

properties.description: Property ids and their new values.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_set_metadata
title: Set element or part metadata
